items.body: `left.Journal, right.Journal = nil, nil` excludes the journal’s non-wall capacity limits along with its permitted storage differences. These limits are not compared elsewhere. Changing only `Journal.Limits.MaximumBytes` leaves the comparison equal; independent `inspect` validation checks each store’s consistency, not equality between campaigns. This misses the explicit requirement to preserve non-wall resource bounds.
items.suggestion: Assert both journals exist and compare their `Limits` before excluding journal storage metadata.
